notes:
{苦悩|くのう} refers to deep mental or emotional anguish—a profound, often prolonged suffering of the mind or spirit.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {苦悩|くのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to suffer, to anguish
- {苦悩|くのう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: full of anguish
- {苦悩|くのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: days of anguish
- ⟦{内面|ないめん}→内面：11689_naimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦悩|くのう}: inner anguish
- {苦悩|くのう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}→解放：00135_kaihou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be freed from suffering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧: pain (often physical, but can be mental)
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship, trouble (from difficulties in life)
- ⟦{苦悶|くもん}→苦悶：28929_kumon⟧: agony, writhing in pain
- ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧: worry, concern (milder than {苦悩|くのう})

REGISTER:
A somewhat literary or formal word, often used in writing, philosophical discussions, or when describing serious emotional states. In casual speech, ⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧ or ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧ is more common.
